_comment: Generated-tone fixture manifest (no third-party audio, ever — AGENTS law 6/coordination). Cue and stem 'file' fields reference keys here; GTA::Fixtures renders them deterministically (same formula as the M1 spike fixtures: amp * 32767 * sin(2*pi*(freq*i/sr + phase)), PCM16 mono). phase 0.25 = cosine start (sample 0 nonzero, needed by first-audible-frame assertions). Real assets from game-two-assets replace this manifest at integration time.
